title: The Mouse Reference Genome: GRCm39 (mm39)
description: The Mouse reference genome (Mus musculus, assembly GRCm39 (mm39)) spans approximately 2.73 Gb across 21 (19 autosomes + X, Y) chromosomes, encoding approx 22,000 protein-coding genes (estimate). This record is the assembly-level overview: the anchor for the deterministic scale chromosome -> gene -> protein product -> pathway -> trait used across this database. REFERENCE GENOME ONLY: a public consensus assembly, never any real person's private genetic data. In the Signature framework this locus is read as a deterministic instruction in the organism's living program: address, operation, and output are fixed by the reference assembly, and every Signature reading stays anchored to the public reference fact.
how_it_works: Genome assembly stitches long sequencing reads into chromosome-scale scaffolds, annotates genes by homology and experiment, and publishes the consensus coordinates everyone references. All records in this database hang off these coordinates deterministically. In the Signature framework this locus is read as a deterministic instruction in the organism's living program: address, operation, and output are fixed by the reference assembly, and every Signature reading stays anchored to the public reference fact.
key_points: Assembly GRCm39 (mm39): the public reference coordinates.
Size approximately 2.73 Gb; 21 (19 autosomes + X, Y).
Gene content: approx 22,000 protein-coding genes (estimate).
standards: Coordinates follow the named assembly GRCm39 (mm39)
Numeric values are approximate unless stated; estimates are labeled
